skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: To Effloresce Whitely
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/To Effloresce Whitely. A gown for Victorian nobles woven with fine muslin, fragrant and supple flowers gracing the pure white skirt. A quiet elegance, delicate and sublime.
skins.quote: A longsword sheathed in stone with vines wrapped around the hilt. Souls of the departed lost to war should, like this sword, go to a quiet place inlaid with white flowers to forever rest in peace.
